obligations.text: The rendered statecraft-ci workflow declares no workflow-level concurrency group.

governance, preflight, code, ai-review and every declared extra job (and an external code call) each have a group of their pull request and job, cancelled in progress only for pull_request; a push and a merge_group run's groups are named by their own run id.
review-exception and ci-gate have no concurrency group, so a run waiting on the owner exception holds nothing a newer run needs.
Rendering tests resolve each job's group and cancel flag per event, show no workflow-level group and none on review-exception or ci-gate, and show the extra and external code jobs carry theirs.

sectionHeadings: 059: Superseded work is cancelled job by job
record.summary: Amends spec 058. Revision 18's single workflow-level concurrency group let a run waiting on the owner-exception Environment hold the group: GitHub does not cancel such a run, so every newer push to the same pull request stayed pending behind it. Every job except review-exception and ci-gate now has a concurrency group of its pull request and job instead, and the workflow has none. Revision 18 keeps its number: no project had adopted the first form.
record.title: Setup profile revision 18 cancels superseded work job by job, so a run waiting on the owner exception never blocks a newer one
